title: Edit Role shows the Parts Department card and Part Library and Inventory group descriptions word for word
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Logged in as Admin (can edit roles). Data: custom role "QA PL View only".
custom_steps:
1. Open Roles & Permissions (Settings > Roles & Permissions per PRD S12-R6; the handoff calls the menu Administration) > Edit Role on "QA PL View only".
  2. Find the Parts Department card and read its description.
  3. Read the permission group under the card: its title and description.
  4. Press Ctrl+F and search the page for "catalog".
  5. Close Edit Role without saving.
custom_expected:
1. Edit Role opens with the permission grid.
  2. The description reads exactly "Manage parts inventory, part library, sales, and vendor operations."
  3. The group is titled "Part Library and Inventory" and its description reads exactly "Manage the parts library and inventory levels."
  4. No "catalog" wording in the Parts Department card or the Part Library and Inventory group (the accounting module's "Accounting Products Catalog" is unrelated and unchanged; don't file).
  5. Nothing is saved; the role is unchanged.
